stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model inference.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformers and llama ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It indicates the model is being used for text-generation tasks.
The associated tags point to its foundation in transformer architecture and use of safetensors.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
stories.author: sohkamyung
bullet_points: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra reportedly solved a complex Enigma message.
This achievement addresses a cryptographic challenge that has remained unsolved since 2005.
The news suggests a significant leap in AI's problem-solving and computational capabilities.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components such as transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30-billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, supporting multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31.
The performance boost is achieved on Apple Silicon by leveraging MLX and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP).
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using its MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also delivers faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new large language model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents entirely on local, personal hardware.
It integrates native support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: OpenAI is addressing a reputational crisis stemming from flawed mathematical outputs.
The company has established an independent panel of elite mathematicians for consultation.
This initiative aims to guide OpenAI and other AI firms on responsible interaction with mathematical research.

stories.title: New Anthropic, OpenAI models make same promise: A little more for a lot less money
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: The AI model competition is shifting from pure capability breakthroughs to cost-efficiency.
Leading models from Anthropic and OpenAI are now focusing on offering better value for less money.
This signals a maturation phase in the frontier AI market, moving toward commercial viability and accessibility.

stories.title: Microsoft disrupts AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 accounts
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft is addressing a significant security vulnerability involving an AI-assisted platform.
The threat actor, EvilTokens, developed a platform designed to accelerate mass account compromises.
The incident resulted in the compromise of approximately 12,000 user accounts.

stories.title: Lawsuit demands OpenAI pay for new school after ChatGPT used in shooting
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A lawsuit has been filed against OpenAI regarding the use of ChatGPT in a shooting incident.
The legal action, initiated in British Columbia, specifically demands access to the shooter's ChatGPT usage logs.
The case highlights growing legal and ethical scrutiny over AI usage in sensitive real-world events.

stories.title: Adobe Premiere finally brings powerful video editing to Android, and it's free
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Adobe Premiere Pro is now available for Android, bringing professional-grade video editing to mobile platforms.
The core functionality of the app is free to use, lowering the barrier to entry for mobile video editors.
Advanced AI features within the application require a paid subscription or extra cost.

stories.title: Toyota orders workers to train humanoid robots but says humans won't be replaced
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Toyota is actively investing in training humanoid robots as part of the automotive industry's push toward advanced robotics.
The company has issued internal directives for workers to engage in training related to these new robotic systems.
Despite the focus on robotics development, Toyota explicitly stated that human workers will not be replaced by these technologies.

stories.title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
stories.author: Mu Chuan
bullet_points: Addresses the fundamental problem of token-level credit assignment in LLM reinforcement learning.
Proposes three mathematical regularity conditions (Completeness, Prefix Consistency, Neutrality) to uniquely define this credit.
Offers a unified theoretical basis for understanding existing LLM training algorithms.

stories.title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
stories.author: Mu Chuan
bullet_points: Addresses a fundamental theoretical gap in Reinforcement Learning (RL) applied to LLMs: the lack of a defined mathematical concept for token-level credit assignment.
Proposes three regularity conditions (Completeness, Prefix Consistency, Neutrality) that uniquely characterize token-level credit.
Offers a unified theoretical framework to explain the behavior and relationships between existing LLM training algorithms.

stories.title: FIRE: Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering for Reliable Language-Model Agents
stories.author: Nivedit Jain
bullet_points: Introduces 'FIRE,' a runtime engineering approach to improve the reliability of language-model agents.
The method uses targeted natural-language instructions and action denials at failure points without altering the core model weights or user prompt.
Demonstrates a meaningful increase in delivered reliability across the Terminal-Bench 2.1 suite, addressing inconsistent performance in LLM agents.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving support on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Paramount will need to release way more movies to make this merger work
stories.author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
bullet_points: Paramount is moving forward with its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) after settling a lawsuit from 12 states.
The merger positions Paramount to become one of the world's largest production houses.
The studio plans to increase spending on film and TV projects by at least $300 million.

stories.title: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Rabbit is releasing a standalone AI agent that is independent of its previous R1 hardware.
The new OS3 agentic operating system runs in the cloud but offers local operation across Windows, Mac, and Linux.
This move shifts the focus from proprietary hardware to accessible, cross-platform software AI.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s new Exobot EVs make the Cybertruck look normal
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Saudi startup Ceer unveiled new, hyper-angular electric vehicles (Exobot EVs).
The launch signals a diversification of Saudi Arabia's industrial focus beyond oil and gas.
The design is noted for its futuristic, 'spaceship-like' aesthetic, drawing comparisons to vehicles like the Cybertruck.

stories.title: Motorola’s wild-looking Signature 27 runs Qualcomm’s new Extreme chipset
stories.author: Dominic Preston
bullet_points: Motorola is launching the Signature 27, featuring Qualcomm's new Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset.
The device is positioned as Motorola's most advanced flagship in several years.
Full specifications, pricing, and release date are currently pending.

stories.title: IT mistake erases 11 years of viewing history for hospitals’ maternity records
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: A critical IT error led to the erasure of 11 years of viewing history for hospital maternity records.
The incident highlights significant data management and backup vulnerabilities within healthcare IT systems.
The affected hospitals were able to recover the core patient care data despite the loss of viewing history.

stories.title: TimeInteract: Towards Real-Time Interactive Intelligence for Streaming Time Series
stories.author: Ming Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of static Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) when dealing with continuously evolving, real-world time series data.
Introduces a novel paradigm called 'Time-Series Interaction' to enable models to perceive and process incoming observations in real-time.
Aims to provide interactive intelligence for streaming time series, allowing for continuous updates during user interaction.

stories.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
stories.author: Weiming Zhi
bullet_points: MAVP addresses a key challenge in mobile manipulation: unreliable execution of base motion during task completion.
The framework improves reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localization feedback.
It aims to solve spatial misalignment issues that commonly cause failures in demonstration-trained policies.

stories.title: FairMean: Promoting Fairness in Distributed Learning under Label Poisoning Attacks
stories.author: Yongxiang Liu
bullet_points: Addresses the conflict between promoting fairness and ensuring robustness in distributed learning.
Introduces FairMean, a method that weights client gradients based on a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss.
The technique prioritizes high-loss clients for fairness while using an upper bound to mitigate the impact of label poisoning attacks.

stories.title: GitScholar: A Dataset for Predicting AI Research Impact from GitHub Engagement
stories.author: Lukas Cavigelli
bullet_points: Introduces GitScholar, a new dataset designed to predict the impact of AI research.
The methodology leverages GitHub engagement data, moving beyond traditional citation analysis.
Aims to solve the problem of information overload in fast-paced AI research by automating impact identification.

stories.title: TransBERT: A Framework for Synthetic Translation in Domain-Specific Language Modeling
stories.author: Patrick Ruch
bullet_points: Introduces TransBERT, a new framework designed to pre-train language models using only synthetically translated text.
Addresses the critical problem of data scarcity for NLP in specialized, non-English domains (demonstrated in life sciences/French).
Presents TransCorpus, a scalable toolkit supporting the synthetic translation process.

stories.title: Geometry-Aware Hyperbolic Residual Quantization
stories.author: Melika Ayoughi
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations in Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) which typically operates in Euclidean space.
It proposes using hyperbolic geometry to naturally model the hierarchical and coarse-to-fine structures inherent in latent codes.
A key technical challenge addressed is overcoming geometric inconsistencies, specifically non-associative hyperbolic addition, in residual aggregation.

stories.title: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
stories.author: Siwei Ma
bullet_points: Introduces TriWorldBench, a new benchmark for evaluating embodied world models.
Addresses the challenge of ensuring consistency between complementary camera views (head and wrist) used by robots.
Focuses on improving robot learning and planning by validating that different views describe the same action and state.

stories.title: CompKV: Compensation-Aware KV Selection for Long-Context LLM Inference
stories.author: Haohuan Fu
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck caused by KV cache traffic during long-context LLM inference.
Proposes 'CompKV,' a method for compensation-aware Key-Value selection to improve sparse attention.
Improves upon existing sparse attention methods that typically select tokens based only on attention mass.

stories.title: On the security and privacy of LLMs in Mobility
stories.author: Umberto Salviati
bullet_points: LLMs are driving a major paradigm shift in the $2.9 trillion global mobility sector.
The integration of AI in mobility affects over 1.5 billion vehicles globally.
The paper addresses critical concerns regarding cybersecurity, privacy, and reliability of LLMs in this domain.

stories.title: OMatG-flash: An All-Atom Flow Map with Reinforce Adjoint Matching for Scalable Materials Discovery
stories.author: Stefano Martiniani
bullet_points: Introduces OMatG-flash, a new all-atom flow map designed for inorganic crystal structure prediction (CSP) and de novo generation (DNG).
Addresses the computational bottleneck in generative AI for materials discovery, which is often caused by the high cost of proposing candidate materials.
Aims to accelerate the materials discovery pipeline, which is crucial for advancements in computing and energy storage.

stories.title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
stories.author: Marc Mézard
bullet_points: The paper challenges the conventional wisdom that overparameterization is always benign in deep learning.
It observes that diffusion models exhibit 'malign overfitting' when highly overparameterized, contrary to expectations.
This finding suggests that the generalization behavior of diffusion models may deviate significantly from standard deep learning theory.

stories.title: TimeInteract: Towards Real-Time Interactive Intelligence for Streaming Time Series
stories.author: Ming Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of static Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) when dealing with continuously evolving, real-world data.
Introduces a novel paradigm called 'Time-Series Interaction' to enable continuous perception of incoming observations.
Aims to achieve real-time interactive intelligence for streaming time series data.

stories.title: On the Lexical Superstition of Large Language Models for Code Comprehension: Re-evaluation on Code of Low Lexical Quality
stories.author: Ming Li
bullet_points: The research investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) over-rely on superficial lexical cues (like identifier names) when understanding code structure.
The study introduces 'Face/Off,' a framework designed to test LLM comprehension by performing semantics-preserving identifier renaming.
Findings challenge the assumption that identifier names are always reliable indicators of semantic meaning in code comprehension tasks.

stories.title: Learning to Defer with Guidance on Real World Medical Data
stories.author: Alison Noble
bullet_points: The research addresses the safety concerns of fully autonomous AI in medical image interpretation.
It introduces 'Learning to Defer' (L2D), a method that selectively routes cases between AI and human experts.
L2D learns optimal routing by analyzing input features and the performance of both the AI model and human clinicians.

stories.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
stories.author: Weiming Zhi
bullet_points: MAVP introduces a framework to enhance mobile manipulation reliability by addressing base motion inconsistencies in demonstration-trained policies.
The core innovation involves predicting explicit base-pose targets and using localization feedback to track them accurately.
The research focuses on coordinating base and arm motion while maintaining precise spatial positioning for successful manipulation.

stories.title: FairMean: Promoting Fairness in Distributed Learning under Label Poisoning Attacks
stories.author: Yongxiang Liu
bullet_points: Addresses the conflict between promoting fairness and ensuring robustness in distributed learning.
Introduces FairMean, a method that weights client gradients based on a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss.
The mechanism prioritizes high-loss clients for fairness while using an upper bound to mitigate the impact of label poisoning attacks.

stories.title: GitScholar: A Dataset for Predicting AI Research Impact from GitHub Engagement
stories.author: Lukas Cavigelli
bullet_points: Introduces GitScholar, a new dataset designed to predict the impact of AI research.
The methodology leverages GitHub engagement metrics alongside traditional publication data.
Addresses the growing challenge researchers face in filtering the massive volume of daily AI publications.

stories.title: HYDRA: Proactive Android Malware Drift Adaptation via Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning
stories.author: Ying Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the critical problem of concept drift in Android malware detection due to malware evolution.
Proposes HYDRA (Hybrid Drift Adaptation), a proactive framework to adapt ML detectors.
Utilizes Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning to overcome limitations of reactive methods and unstable adversarial training.

stories.title: On the Lexical Superstition of Large Language Models for Code Comprehension: Re-evaluation on Code of Low Lexical Quality
stories.author: Ming Li
bullet_points: The research investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) over-rely on superficial lexical cues (like variable names) when performing code comprehension.
The study introduces 'Face/Off,' a framework designed to test identifier renaming while preserving the underlying program structure.
Findings challenge the assumption that identifier names are always reliable indicators of semantic meaning in naturally occurring code.

stories.title: Layout-Guided Masking for GROBID: Lightweight Structural Gains in Large-Scale Scientific PDF Ingestion
stories.author: Vipul Gupta
bullet_points: The research addresses the bottleneck of converting complex scientific PDFs into machine-readable text.
It proposes integrating a lightweight, CPU-based layout detector with GROBID, a standard CPU-based parser.
The goal is to achieve structural gains in PDF ingestion without requiring resource-intensive GPUs, improving scalability.

stories.title: HySparse2: Hybrid Sparse Attention with Two-Level KV Sharing
stories.author: Fuli Luo
bullet_points: Introduces HySparse2, a new hybrid sparse attention architecture designed for long-horizon and multi-turn agents.
Addresses key challenges in large context processing, specifically efficient prefill and compact KV-cache storage.
Features a two-level KV sharing mechanism, utilizing a YOCO-style self-decoder and cross-decoder structure at the outer level.

stories.title: TransBERT: A Framework for Synthetic Translation in Domain-Specific Language Modeling
stories.author: Patrick Ruch
bullet_points: Introduces TransBERT, a new framework for pre-training language models using synthetic translation.
Addresses the critical problem of scarce non-English language data in specialized domains (e.g., life sciences).
Demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in downstream NLP tasks using only synthetically translated text.

stories.title: CHiME-9 ECHI: A Machine Learning Challenge for Enhancing Conversations to Address Hearing Impairment
stories.author: Jon Barker
bullet_points: The paper introduces CHiME-9, a machine learning challenge focused on enhancing conversations for hearing-impaired individuals.
The challenge simulates complex, real-world scenarios, including four-party conversations in noisy, cafeteria-style environments with interfering speech.
It utilizes specialized audio data captured via Meta Aria glasses and hearing aid microphones to test speech extraction capabilities.

stories.title: Truth for Believable AI: Expressed Doubt, Provenance, and Belief Revision as an Engineerable Stance
stories.author: Sebastian Cochinescu
bullet_points: Proposes an engineering framework to add epistemic states (doubt, provenance, belief revision) to existing language models.
The system integrates per-claim confidence, typed provenance tracking, and a persistent revision store.
Focuses on implementing these behavioral layers rather than validating the resulting AI's overall believability or trustworthiness.

stories.title: 38% of an analyst's questions get "no records found" when the data is right there
stories.author: ashish_sinha_5241c7673d93
bullet_points: The article discusses a critical failure mode in text-to-SQL agents.
This failure mode results in the agent returning 'no records found' even when data exists.
The issue is problematic because it lacks logging or alerting mechanisms.
